input.summary: Remove the all-requirements sourcing obligation in Section 10.3(A) and confirm M&I is a non-exclusive provider.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3(A) requires us to source all Monthly Base Fee Services from M&I for the entire eight-year Term with no performance-based exit, which is exclusive dealing we cannot accept. We have replaced that sentence so M&I is a non-exclusive provider and we remain free to obtain services elsewhere; if M&I needs some commitment we can discuss a defined category capped at 12 months that ends automatically on any failure to meet the Performance Standards or delivery dates.

ops.oldText: Customer agrees that, during the Term, Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services which are included in the Monthly Base Fee, as set forth on Schedule 6.2.
ops.newText: M&I shall be a non-exclusive provider of the Services, and Customer shall have no obligation to obtain any Services exclusively from M&I.
